newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open barely changed on Monday, trading sources said.
May futures gained 0.04 cent a lb on Friday to close at 10.97, after trading from 10.93 to 11.03. July gained 0.06 cent to 10.74, as the nearby premium narrowed to 0.23 cent.

Although the benchmark contract closed below 11.00 cents, traders said its ability to hold the 10.95 level was encouraging and could fuel additional buying in the near-term. Unless physical buying picked up, a hefty speculative long position could temper the market's enthusiasm, they added.
Resistance was pegged at the recent high of 11.08 cents in May, with support seen in the mid-1080s.
In London, white sugar futures had barely moved by midday. By 0845 EST, 1345 GMT, LIFFE May was 20 cents firmer at $308.50 a tonne.
